summary: Round 1 (new module). properSMul_of_le_one / t2Space_coneBase_of_le_one are correct and honest. The index convention is right: Lean n ≤ 1 means V on RnO (n+1) with n+1 ≤ 2, which is Benzécri's n ≤ 2. The hypotheses are exactly an affine conical manifold plus V Hausdorff; second countability and connectedness are dropped (weakened). The proof is not vacuous: the hypotheses are satisfiable (the model RnO 2 itself is checked), and the same ProperSMul predicate is refuted for n = 3 by ConeCex.not_properSMul, so it is not trivially true. The only local instance is local. No issue. Ready to graduate.

checks.proof_dim2: Ultrafilter criterion (ConeBase.properSMul_of_tendsto). Rays near f(m) are parametrised by s ∈ (−δ, δ) (rv, projective coordinate kf/lf); R G s = « near p(s), f' = G ∘ f, and f'(p(s)) in the cone K' = {|κ| < δ' ℓ} around f'(m') ». H1 (rigidity, eq_of_eventually_smul_eq by IsAnalyticAction), H2 (openness), H3 (closedness at a left/right limit — uses T2 V), H4, H5 (injectivity of f' on rays: equal projective coordinate forces positive proportionality, then the base parameter coincides). exists_endpoint + eventually_eq_of_left/right: each component reaches 0 or exits K' through one of its two boundary rays κ/ℓ = ±δ', and two components exiting through the same ray share an interior value (IVT), hence coincide by H5 and H1 — so the ultrafilter sees one transition G₀, and ‖f'(m_i)‖ = ‖G₀ f(m_i)‖ → ‖G₀ f(m)‖. This is the audit's argument localised; the reasoning is sound, and the kernel checks it (axioms: the standard three)

fidelity_summary: DEC-122's n ≤ 2 theorem is formalized in full. For a Hausdorff affine conical manifold of Benzécri's dimension n ≤ 2 (Lean n ≤ 1), the ℝ₊*-action is proper and the base is Hausdorff, so Prop. 2, Déf. 3's triviality and the p. 241 section hold as printed in that range (with Cone/Section's second countability for the last two). The index convention is right, the hypotheses are honest, and the proof is not vacuous. Ready to graduate.
